chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub al-Kulayni narrated to me from a group of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, who said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him): 'How should I say peace to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) at his grave?'

He replied: 'Peace to the Messenger of Allah. Peace to you, O beloved of Allah! Peace to you, O choice of Allah! Peace to you, O trustee of Allah! I testify that you advised your nation, and you strove in the way of Allah, and worshipped Him sincerely until death (certainty) came to you. May Allah reward you with the best reward that He has given any prophet for his nation.'
O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, (blessings) greater than that which You sent upon Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim. Verily You are the Praiseworthy, the Glorious.
ai.seo_question: What is the correct way to say peace and make supplication at the grave of the Prophet Muhammad according to Shia tradition?
ai.summary: This narration from *Kamil al-Ziyarah* establishes the canonical formula for visiting the Prophet’s grave, emphasizing titles like 'Yā Ḥabīb Allāh' and testifying to his sincere devotion until death. It reflects the Shia tradition of combining direct address with intercessory prayer, linking the Prophet’s earthly struggle to divine recompense. The invocation concludes with a comparison to the blessings upon Ibrahim, highlighting the universality of the Prophet’s mission.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 6. Muḥammad ibn Ya’qūb Al-Kulayni narrated to me from a group of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyād, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Abī Nasr, who said:
I asked Abal Ḥasan (Imam Riďā (a.s.)), “How should I say Salām to the Messenger of Allāh (s.a.a.w.) next to his grave?”

Imam (a.s.) replied:                    Salām upon the Messenger of Allāh. Salām to you, O love of Allāh! Salām to you, O choice of Allāh! Salām to you, O trustee of Allāh!               I testify that you advised your nation. You fought in the way of Allāh and worshipped Him with loyalty until that which is certain (death) came to you.         May Allāh reward you with a greater reward than He has given to any (other) prophet for guiding his nation.

O Allāh! Send (Your) blessing on Muḥammad and the family of Muḥammad, (blessings which are) greater than that which You sent on Ibrāhīm and the family of Ibrāhīm. Verily You are the Praised, the Glorified.
